Subject: Vendor setup: Luminex Labs invoices (June batch) — need tax docs & remit

Hi Vivek,

Hope you're well — we're ready to process the June invoice batch (three invoices, total $42,380) but need two items to clear payment in our AR system:

1) A completed W-9 or W-8BEN-E (depending on your tax residency) with an EIN or foreign tax ID.
2) Official remit/ACH instructions for Redwood so our AP team can push payment (we pay via ACH for US vendors).

Quick background: Luminex requires the name on the tax form to match the remit entity on the invoice to avoid 1099/withholding mismatches. Also, if Redwood is a US 1099-eligible payee, we need a 1099 classification (C corp / S corp / LLC taxed as).

Can you send the completed W-9 (or confirm you are a foreign entity and will provide W-8BEN-E) and the ACH routing file? We have a payment cutoff this Friday 10th.

If you'd prefer, we can open a DocuSign so an authorized signer can sign the attestation.

Thanks — appreciate a quick turnaround.

Cheers,
Marisa Cho
Accounts Payable Lead | Luminex Labs
(attachment: Luminex_INV_20260630_batch.pdf)
